title: Nice to meet you!
goal_en: Write 4 sentences introducing yourself to someone new: your name, where you're from, your job, and why you're in Mexico.

beats.en: Say hello and give your name.
Say where you're from.
Say what you do (no un/una!).
Say you're in Mexico on vacation and you're very happy.

model_es: Hola, me llamo Matt. Soy de Houston, en Estados Unidos. Soy ingeniero e investigador. Estoy en México de vacaciones y estoy muy contento.
model_en: Hi, my name is Matt. I'm from Houston, in the United States. I'm an engineer and a researcher. I'm in Mexico on vacation and I'm very happy.

title: Arriving in Mexico City
goal_en: Write 5 sentences in the present: you land, take a taxi, find your hotel, describe the room and say how you feel.

beats.en: You land at the Mexico City airport in the afternoon.
You take an authorized taxi to the center.
The hotel is on a quiet street.
In the room there's a big bed and a small window.
You're tired but very happy.

model_es: Llego al aeropuerto de la Ciudad de México en la tarde. Tomo un taxi autorizado al centro. El hotel está en una calle tranquila. En el cuarto hay una cama grande y una ventana pequeña. Estoy cansado, pero muy contento.
model_en: I land at the Mexico City airport in the afternoon. I take an authorized taxi to the center. The hotel is on a quiet street. In the room there's a big bed and a small window. I'm tired, but very happy.

title: A day of tacos and markets
goal_en: Write 6 sentences in the present about a day of eating your way through a market.

beats.en: In the morning you walk to the Coyoacán market.
There are lots of fruits and colors.
You buy three mangoes and a papaya.
At midday you eat suadero tacos at a stand.
You also drink an agua de jamaica.
Everything is cheap — and it tastes great!

model_es: En la mañana camino al mercado de Coyoacán. Hay muchas frutas y muchos colores. Compro tres mangos y una papaya. A mediodía como tacos de suadero en un puesto. También tomo un agua de jamaica. ¡Todo es barato y está muy rico!
model_en: In the morning I walk to the Coyoacán market. There are lots of fruits and colors. I buy three mangoes and a papaya. At midday I eat suadero tacos at a stand. I also drink an agua de jamaica (hibiscus water). Everything is cheap and it's really tasty!

title: Meeting a new friend
goal_en: Write 7–8 sentences about someone you meet in a café: who she is, where she's from, her age and job, what you ask her, and what you do together.

beats.en: Today in a café you talk with a woman. Her name is Lucía.
beats.hint_es: Hoy hablo con una chica… Se llama…

beats.en: She's from Puebla but lives in Mexico City.
She's 29 and she's a teacher.
You ask her what there is to eat in Puebla.
She says mole poblano is delicious.
You're both hungry, so you eat some tacos together.
You have to go back to the hotel at six, but you have her number.

model_es: Hoy hablo con una chica en un café. Se llama Lucía. Es de Puebla, pero vive en la Ciudad de México. Tiene veintinueve años y es maestra. Le pregunto qué hay de comer en Puebla. Ella dice que el mole poblano es muy rico. Tenemos hambre y comemos unos tacos juntos. Tengo que regresar al hotel a las seis, pero ya tengo su número.
model_en: Today I talk with a woman in a café. Her name is Lucía. She's from Puebla, but she lives in Mexico City. She's 29 and she's a teacher. I ask her what there is to eat in Puebla. She says mole poblano is really good. We're hungry, so we eat some tacos together. I have to go back to the hotel at six, but now I have her number.

title: Planning a trip to Teotihuacán
goal_en: Write 7 sentences about tomorrow's plan using ir a + infinitive: when you leave, how you get there, what you'll see, what you'll bring, and when you'll come back.

beats.en: Tomorrow you're going to visit Teotihuacán with your friend Daniel.
You're going to leave the hotel at seven in the morning.
You're going to take a bus from the Terminal del Norte.
There you're going to walk the Avenue of the Dead and see the Pyramid of the Sun.
It's going to be hot, so you're going to bring water and a hat.
At midday you're going to eat at a restaurant near the pyramids.
You're going to come back at night, tired but happy.

model_es: Mañana voy a visitar Teotihuacán con mi amigo Daniel. Vamos a salir del hotel a las siete de la mañana. Vamos a tomar un camión en la Terminal del Norte. Allá vamos a caminar por la Calzada de los Muertos y ver la Pirámide del Sol. Va a hacer calor, entonces voy a llevar agua y un sombrero. A mediodía vamos a comer en un restaurante cerca de las pirámides. Vamos a regresar en la noche, muy cansados pero contentos.
model_en: Tomorrow I'm going to visit Teotihuacán with my friend Daniel. We're going to leave the hotel at seven in the morning. We're going to take a bus at the Terminal del Norte. There we're going to walk along the Avenue of the Dead and see the Pyramid of the Sun. It's going to be hot, so I'm going to bring water and a hat. At midday we're going to eat at a restaurant near the pyramids. We're going to come back at night, very tired but happy.

title: A museum day
goal_en: Write 7 sentences about a day at the Museo Nacional de Antropología, using querer, poder, preferir, entender and volver.

beats.en: Today you want to visit the National Museum of Anthropology.
It opens at nine and closes at six.
The ticket doesn't cost much.
You can't touch anything, but you can take photos.
You prefer the Mexica hall, where the Sun Stone is.
You don't understand everything, but you ask the guide.
After four hours you're very hungry and go back to the hotel.

model_es: Hoy quiero visitar el Museo Nacional de Antropología. El museo abre a las nueve y cierra a las seis. El boleto no cuesta mucho. No puedo tocar nada, pero sí puedo tomar fotos. Prefiero la sala mexica, donde está la Piedra del Sol. No entiendo todo, pero le pregunto a la guía. Después de cuatro horas tengo mucha hambre y vuelvo al hotel.
model_en: Today I want to visit the National Museum of Anthropology. The museum opens at nine and closes at six. The ticket doesn't cost much. I can't touch anything, but I can take photos. I prefer the Mexica hall, where the Sun Stone is. I don't understand everything, but I ask the guide. After four hours I'm really hungry and I go back to the hotel.

title: A mezcal tasting
goal_en: Write 7–8 sentences about a mezcal tasting: where, what's on the table, what you like and love, what your friend doesn't like, and how you feel at the end.

beats.en: Tonight you go to a mezcal tasting in Colonia Roma.
beats.hint_es: Esta noche voy a una cata…

beats.en: The mezcalero explains that mezcal comes from agave.
On the table there are four mezcals, with orange and sal de gusano.
You like the espadín a lot.
You love the tobalá: it's smooth and a little smoky.
Your friend doesn't like the last one because it's very strong.
beats.hint_es: A mi amigo no le gusta…

beats.en: At the end your head hurts a little, but you're very happy.

model_es: Esta noche voy a una cata de mezcal en la colonia Roma. El mezcalero nos explica que el mezcal viene del agave. En la mesa hay cuatro mezcales, con naranja y sal de gusano. Me gusta mucho el espadín. ¡Y me encanta el tobalá! Es suave y un poco ahumado. A mi amigo no le gusta el último porque es muy fuerte. Al final me duele un poco la cabeza, pero estoy muy contento.
model_en: Tonight I go to a mezcal tasting in Colonia Roma. The mezcalero explains to us that mezcal comes from agave. On the table there are four mezcals, with orange slices and worm salt. I really like the espadín. And I love the tobalá! It's smooth and a little smoky. My friend doesn't like the last one because it's very strong. At the end my head hurts a little, but I'm very happy.

title: A problem at the hotel
goal_en: Write 8 sentences about a problem in your hotel room and how it gets solved. Use le / me with explicar, decir, pedir and dar.

beats.en: You come back to your room at ten at night.
The air conditioning doesn't work and there's no hot water.
You call reception and explain the problem to the receptionist.
beats.hint_es: Llamo a recepción y le explico…

beats.en: She tells you she'll send someone right away.
Thirty minutes go by and nobody comes.
You go down to reception and ask for another room.
beats.hint_es: Bajo a recepción y le pido…

beats.en: They give you a new room and a free breakfast.
Not bad!

model_es: Regreso a mi cuarto a las diez de la noche. El aire acondicionado no funciona y no hay agua caliente. Llamo a recepción y le explico el problema a la recepcionista. Ella me dice que ahorita manda a alguien. Pero pasan treinta minutos y no viene nadie. Entonces bajo a recepción y le pido otro cuarto. Me dan un cuarto nuevo y, además, un desayuno gratis. ¡No está mal!
model_en: I come back to my room at ten at night. The air conditioning doesn't work and there's no hot water. I call reception and explain the problem to the receptionist. She tells me she'll send someone right away. But thirty minutes go by and nobody comes. So I go down to reception and ask for another room. They give me a new room and, on top of that, a free breakfast. Not bad!

title: Lost in the Centro
goal_en: Write 8 sentences: you get lost downtown, ask a street vendor for directions (quote her usted commands), and find your way.

beats.en: You're walking in the Centro Histórico and you're lost.
beats.hint_es: Camino por el Centro Histórico y…

beats.en: Your phone has no battery.
You ask a lady who sells elotes: 'Excuse me, where is the Palacio de Bellas Artes?'
She says: 'Go straight down Madero street and cross the Eje Central. It's on the right.'
You thank her and buy an elote from her.
Ten minutes later you see the building. It's gorgeous!
Next time you're going to charge your phone!

model_es: Camino por el Centro Histórico y estoy perdido. Mi celular no tiene pila. Le pregunto a una señora que vende elotes: «Disculpe, ¿dónde está el Palacio de Bellas Artes?» Ella me dice: «Siga derecho por la calle Madero y cruce el Eje Central. Está a la derecha.» Le doy las gracias y le compro un elote. Diez minutos después, veo el edificio. ¡Es precioso! La próxima vez voy a cargar mi celular.
model_en: I'm walking around the Historic Center and I'm lost. My phone has no battery. I ask a lady who sells corn on the cob: "Excuse me, where is the Palacio de Bellas Artes?" She tells me: "Go straight along Madero street and cross the Eje Central. It's on the right." I thank her and buy an elote from her. Ten minutes later, I see the building. It's gorgeous! Next time I'm going to charge my phone.

title: Telling someone about my work
goal_en: A new friend asks about your job. Write 8 sentences: what you do and where, your daily routine (reflexive verbs), and what you like about it.

beats.en: You're an engineer and you work at a university in Houston.
You study the brain: your team makes tiny sensors that measure its electrical activity.
You get up at six and have a coffee.
beats.hint_es: Me levanto a las seis y…

beats.en: Then you drive to the lab.
In the morning you write code and read papers.
In the afternoon you have meetings with your team.
You love your work, but sometimes you get very tired.
Many nights you go to bed late because you're thinking about the data.

model_es: Soy ingeniero y trabajo en una universidad en Houston. Estudio el cerebro: hacemos sensores muy pequeños que miden su actividad eléctrica. Me levanto a las seis y me tomo un café. Después voy al laboratorio en carro. En la mañana escribo código y leo artículos. En la tarde tengo juntas con mi equipo. Me encanta mi trabajo, pero a veces me canso mucho. Muchas noches me acuesto tarde porque pienso en los datos.
model_en: I'm an engineer and I work at a university in Houston. I study the brain: we make very small sensors that measure its electrical activity. I get up at six and have a coffee. Then I drive to the lab. In the morning I write code and read papers. In the afternoon I have meetings with my team. I love my job, but sometimes I get really tired. Many nights I go to bed late because I'm thinking about the data.

title: Día de Muertos night
goal_en: Write 9 sentences in the present about walking through Coyoacán on the night of November 1st. Use estar + -ando/-iendo and para / por.

beats.en: It's the night of November 1st and you're walking through Coyoacán.
beats.hint_es: Es la noche del primero de noviembre y estoy…

beats.en: There are ofrendas everywhere, with photos, candles and cempasúchil flowers.
The orange flowers are to guide the souls home.
A family is putting pan de muerto and a bottle of tequila on their ofrenda.
The grandmother explains that the tequila is for her husband, who is no longer here.
Lots of people have their faces painted like catrinas.
You buy a sugar skull for your sister.
beats.hint_es: Compro una calavera de azúcar para…

beats.en: Then you walk around the plaza for two hours.
You're tired, but it's an incredible night.

model_es: Es la noche del primero de noviembre y estoy caminando por Coyoacán. Hay ofrendas por todas partes, con fotos, velas y flores de cempasúchil. Las flores anaranjadas son para guiar a las almas a casa. Una familia está poniendo pan de muerto y una botella de tequila en su ofrenda. La abuela me explica que el tequila es para su esposo, que ya no está. Mucha gente lleva la cara pintada de catrina. Compro una calavera de azúcar para mi hermana. Luego camino por la plaza durante dos horas. Estoy cansado, pero es una noche increíble.
model_en: It's the night of November 1st and I'm walking through Coyoacán. There are ofrendas everywhere, with photos, candles and cempasúchil (marigold) flowers. The orange flowers are there to guide the souls home. A family is putting pan de muerto and a bottle of tequila on their ofrenda. The grandmother explains to me that the tequila is for her husband, who is no longer with us. Lots of people have their faces painted like catrinas. I buy a sugar skull for my sister. Then I walk around the plaza for two hours. I'm tired, but it's an incredible night.

title: What I did yesterday
goal_en: Write 8 sentences in the preterite about yesterday in Coyoacán: morning, museum, afternoon, evening.

beats.en: Yesterday you got up late, at nine.
You had green chilaquiles for breakfast at a fonda.
Then you visited the Casa Azul, Frida Kahlo's museum.
You bought the tickets online the night before.
You walked through the garden and took lots of photos.
At four it started to rain.
So you and your friend ate tostadas at the Coyoacán market.
beats.hint_es: Entonces mi amigo y yo comimos…

beats.en: In the evening you went back to the hotel by Uber.

model_es: Ayer me levanté tarde, a las nueve. Desayuné chilaquiles verdes en una fonda. Después visité la Casa Azul, el museo de Frida Kahlo. Compré los boletos en línea la noche anterior. Caminé por el jardín y tomé muchas fotos. A las cuatro empezó a llover. Entonces mi amigo y yo comimos tostadas en el mercado de Coyoacán. En la noche regresé al hotel en Uber.
model_en: Yesterday I got up late, at nine. I had green chilaquiles for breakfast at a fonda (small family restaurant). Then I visited the Casa Azul, Frida Kahlo's museum. I'd bought the tickets online the night before. I walked through the garden and took lots of photos. At four it started to rain. So my friend and I ate tostadas at the Coyoacán market. In the evening I went back to the hotel by Uber.

title: A day at the pyramids
goal_en: Write 9–10 sentences in the past about your trip to Teotihuacán, using fui, tuve, hizo, traje, vimos and fue.

beats.en: Last Saturday you went to Teotihuacán with some friends.
You had to get up at six in the morning.
The bus ride took an hour.
You walked along the Avenue of the Dead and saw the Pyramids of the Sun and the Moon.
It was very hot and you didn't bring a hat, so you bought one from a vendor.
beats.hint_es: Hizo mucho calor y no traje…

beats.en: You saw colorful hot-air balloons in the sky.
Afterwards you ate at a restaurant inside a cave.
You were at the pyramids for five hours.
You came back exhausted, but it was an incredible day.

model_es: El sábado pasado fui a Teotihuacán con unos amigos. Tuve que levantarme a las seis de la mañana. El viaje en camión duró una hora. Caminamos por la Calzada de los Muertos y vimos la Pirámide del Sol y la Pirámide de la Luna. Hizo mucho calor y yo no traje sombrero, así que le compré uno a un vendedor. En el cielo vimos globos aerostáticos de muchos colores. Después comimos en un restaurante dentro de una cueva. Estuve en las pirámides cinco horas. Regresamos muertos de cansancio, pero fue un día increíble.
model_en: Last Saturday I went to Teotihuacán with some friends. I had to get up at six in the morning. The bus ride took an hour. We walked along the Avenue of the Dead and saw the Pyramid of the Sun and the Pyramid of the Moon. It was very hot and I didn't bring a hat, so I bought one from a vendor. In the sky we saw hot-air balloons of many colors. Afterwards we ate at a restaurant inside a cave. I was at the pyramids for five hours. We came back dead tired, but it was an incredible day.

title: A night in the cemetery
goal_en: Tell the story of a Día de Muertos night at a cemetery, in the past. Set the scene with the imperfect (time, weather, what people were doing) and tell the events with the preterite. 10–11 sentences.

beats.en: On the night of November 1st you went to a cemetery near the city.
beats.hint_es: La noche del primero de noviembre fui…

beats.en: It was ten at night and it was a little cold.
There were thousands of candles and marigolds on the graves.
Families were eating, chatting and listening to music next to their dead.
Some mariachis were playing a very sad song.
Suddenly, a lady invited you to sit with her family.
beats.hint_es: De repente, una señora me invitó…

beats.en: She told you her husband was very cheerful and loved to dance.
beats.hint_es: Me contó que su esposo era… y que le encantaba…

beats.en: She gave you two tamales and a cup of atole.
You stayed with them until midnight.
When you left the cemetery, you felt very grateful.
beats.hint_es: Cuando salí del panteón, me sentía…

model_es: La noche del primero de noviembre fui a un panteón cerca de la ciudad. Eran las diez de la noche y hacía un poco de frío. Había miles de velas y flores de cempasúchil sobre las tumbas. Las familias comían, platicaban y escuchaban música junto a sus muertos. Unos mariachis tocaban una canción muy triste. De repente, una señora me invitó a sentarme con su familia. Me contó que su esposo era muy alegre y que le encantaba bailar. Me dio dos tamales y una taza de atole. Me quedé con ellos hasta la medianoche. Cuando salí del panteón, me sentía muy agradecido.
model_en: On the night of November 1st I went to a cemetery near the city. It was ten at night and it was a little cold. There were thousands of candles and marigolds on the graves. Families were eating, chatting and listening to music next to their dead. Some mariachis were playing a very sad song. Suddenly, a lady invited me to sit with her family. She told me her husband had been very cheerful and that he loved to dance. She gave me two tamales and a cup of atole. I stayed with them until midnight. When I left the cemetery, I felt very grateful.

title: A thank-you message
goal_en: Write a thank-you message (9–10 sentences) to Lucía, your friend from Puebla, after your trip: thank her, remember the best moments, compare, and invite her to visit.

beats.en: Greet Lucía warmly.
Thank her for everything this week.
Say the dinner at her parents' house was the best meal of your trip.
beats.hint_es: La cena en casa de tus papás fue…

beats.en: Say her mom's mole is better than the mole at any restaurant.
beats.hint_es: ¡El mole de tu mamá es mejor que…!

beats.en: Remember that you laughed a lot when you got lost in the metro.
Say you learned lots of new words with her.
Say Mexico City is now one of your favorite cities.
beats.hint_es: Ahora la Ciudad de México es…

beats.en: Tell her she has to visit you in Houston someday.
Say you hope to see her soon, and sign off with a hug.

model_es:
Querida Lucía:
Muchas gracias por todo esta semana. La cena en casa de tus papás fue la mejor comida de mi viaje. ¡El mole de tu mamá es mejor que el mole de cualquier restaurante! También nos reímos mucho cuando nos perdimos en el metro. Contigo aprendí muchas palabras nuevas. Ahora la Ciudad de México es una de mis ciudades favoritas. Tienes que visitarme en Houston algún día. Espero verte pronto.
Un abrazo,
Matt
model_en:
Dear Lucía,
Thank you so much for everything this week. The dinner at your parents' house was the best meal of my trip. Your mom's mole is better than the mole at any restaurant! We also laughed a lot when we got lost in the metro. With you I learned lots of new words. Now Mexico City is one of my favorite cities. You have to visit me in Houston someday. I hope to see you soon.
A hug,
Matt

title: My next trip
goal_en: Write 10–12 sentences: look back on this trip (preterite + imperfect), plan the next one (ir a + infinitive), and finish with a wish (quiero que…, ojalá).

beats.en: On this trip you spent five days in Mexico City.
You saw Día de Muertos for the first time and it was unforgettable.
beats.hint_es: Vi el Día de Muertos por primera vez y…

beats.en: When you arrived, you understood very little Spanish and were shy about speaking.
beats.hint_es: Cuando llegué, entendía… y me daba pena…

beats.en: Now you can order food, ask how to get places and chat a little.
Next time you're going to stay two weeks.
First you're going to Oaxaca to try the moles and the mezcal.
beats.hint_es: Primero voy a ir a Oaxaca para…

beats.en: Then you want to go to the beach in Puerto Escondido.
You're also going to take Spanish classes every morning.
You want your friend Lucía to come with you for a few days.
Hopefully you can come back very soon!

model_es: En este viaje pasé cinco días en la Ciudad de México. Vi el Día de Muertos por primera vez y fue inolvidable. Cuando llegué, entendía muy poco español y me daba pena hablar. Ahora puedo pedir comida, preguntar cómo llegar a los lugares y platicar un poco con la gente. La próxima vez voy a quedarme dos semanas. Primero voy a ir a Oaxaca para probar los moles y el mezcal. Después quiero ir a la playa en Puerto Escondido. Además, voy a tomar clases de español todas las mañanas. Quiero que mi amiga Lucía venga conmigo unos días. ¡Ojalá que pueda volver muy pronto! México, ¡nos vemos pronto!
model_en: On this trip I spent five days in Mexico City. I saw Día de Muertos for the first time and it was unforgettable. When I arrived, I understood very little Spanish and I was shy about speaking. Now I can order food, ask how to get places and chat a little with people. Next time I'm going to stay two weeks. First I'm going to go to Oaxaca to try the moles and the mezcal. Then I want to go to the beach in Puerto Escondido. Also, I'm going to take Spanish classes every morning. I want my friend Lucía to come with me for a few days. I hope I can come back very soon! Mexico, see you soon!
